evidence.title: Large Language Models for Manufacturing
evidence.methodology: comprehensive academic survey and task evaluation across manufacturing domains
evidence.inference: Manufacturing data is highly complex, siloed, domain-specific, and governed by strict regulatory frameworks, creating major data preparation and governance barriers.

evidence.stated_factor: exceptionally high precision and outcome reliability expectations in engineering disciplines
evidence.evidence_quote: Given the proximity of manufacturing to engineering disciplines, the expectations for outcomes generated by LLMs in this field are notably high.
evidence.title: Large Language Models for Manufacturing
evidence.methodology: comprehensive academic survey and task evaluation across manufacturing domains
evidence.inference: Engineering and manufacturing require deterministic precision and zero-defect tolerance; standard LLM non-determinism and hallucination rates inhibit adoption.

evidence.title: Bridging the Knowledge Gap: Using Generative AI on AWS to Preserve Critical Expertise
evidence.methodology: enterprise case study (Georgia-Pacific) and architecture implementation
evidence.inference: Severe demographic shifts and unfilled skilled manufacturing roles force organizations to deploy GenAI copilots to bridge knowledge gaps.

evidence.evidence_quote: The absence of a centralized, readily available knowledge base makes it difficult for workers to find the right information quickly when issues arise. This leads to reduced machine productivity, prolonged downtime, and higher troubleshooting and repair costs across manufacturing facilities.
evidence.title: Bridging the Knowledge Gap: Using Generative AI on AWS to Preserve Critical Expertise
evidence.methodology: enterprise case study (Georgia-Pacific) and architecture implementation
evidence.inference: Unstructured, fragmented plant documentation and disconnected enterprise systems prevent effective retrieval and knowledge grounding.

evidence.methodology: enterprise case study (Georgia-Pacific) and architecture implementation
evidence.inference: Need to capture and codify unstructured tacit plant knowledge before senior operators retire drives copilot and Q&A assistant adoption.
evidence.framing_bias: Vendor uses tribal knowledge loss to position generative AI as the single solution for knowledge retention.

evidence.stated_factor: Autonomous customer care and proactive churn intervention
evidence.evidence_quote: The future of customer service in the telecommunications industry is AI-enabled agents, and we see three areas of transformation. Second, for call centers, bots can provide the first touchpoint for customers, helping answer simpler questions so that human agents are reserved for more complex cases... Third, telecom companies are starting to apply predictive analytics of customer churn to focus on better serving customers at risk of switching to competitors.
evidence.title: The $28 Billion Gap: How AI Can Cut US Telecom Costs
evidence.methodology: Bain financial and operational analysis of six major US telecom operators
evidence.inference: Contact center call deflection and churn prevention directly drive revenue retention and operational cost reduction.

evidence.stated_factor: Augmentation and task complementarity for white-collar federal knowledge workers
evidence.evidence_quote: Through cutting-edge analysis of federal occupations, Dr. Resh and his team discovered that generative AI (GenAI) functions primarily as an enhancer rather than an eliminator of jobs. In most federal roles, GenAI serves as a force multiplier. For instance, white-collar professionals can delegate routine data processing to AI, freeing them to focus on high-value analysis. The analysis shows high scores for complementarity (AI working alongside humans) and augmentation (AI extending human abilities), with substitutivity (full replacement) remaining moderate to low.
evidence.title: New Report - GenAI and the Future of Government Work
evidence.publisher: IBM Center for The Business of Government
evidence.methodology: Occupational and task analysis of U.S. federal civil service job classifications by Georgia State University researchers
evidence.inference: Augmentation rather than job displacement lowers adoption friction, reassuring public sector workers and boosting analytical productivity.

evidence.title: The Dangerous Accountability Gap in Federal AI Use
evidence.methodology: Survey of federal IT executives by Market Connections
evidence.inference: Mandating human-in-the-loop approval for every action on sensitive national security data stems from risk committee requirements and lack of auditable, reversible agent execution guardrails.
